QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Please Help Repair Baroq's Wall
QuestInfo.0: Black Wings' secretary #b#p2154002##k at the #m310050000# in the Mine is still struggling with so many things to do. Talk to #p2154002#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154002# says #p2154000# and #p2154001# destroyed the wall, which must be repaired. However, the #o7150000#s aren't listening, so she wants you to teach the #o7150000#s a lesson. Defeat those #o7150000#s.\n\n#o7150000##r #a239561##k
QuestInfo.2: #p2154002# was really happy that you taught those #o7150000#s a lesson.

0.0: Oh no, not again. It wasn't me, it was #p2154000# and #p2154001#. They broke the wall while practicing. And it was the wall to Baroq's room too... Argh! This is going to cost more money. We're gonna be in the red again. Aaah!
0.1: As much as I hate being in the red, I'm going to have to get that wall repaired. I told the #o7150000# enemies to repair it, but they just aren't listening. I think they're going to have to be taught a lesson. Can you help?

yes.0: Yeah! Thank you. All right, please take care of #r50 #o7150000# enemies#k. That should make them listen up.

no.0: Please reconsider! If you refuse, we'll need to set a lot of money aside for the repairs. Then the Black Wings budget will be slashed and every Black Wing will see a decrease in their salaries--starting with yours, since you're the newest!

1.0: Did you teach the #o7150000#s a lesson?

yes.0: Baroq is gonna be livid if the walls aren't repaired. He has such lofty tastes, he won't be happy without marble walls. He acts like such a princess, sheesh.

mob.0: Have you taken care of those #r50 #o7150000# enemies#k yet? They aren't going to obey unless you do...
